request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read CLAUDE.md — it states the working rules, the project layout, and the data-testid
conventions. Follow it.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Let me narrow that list to one stage. For example only the ones I have sent.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, and any audit records it
expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as you work;
iterate until it passes. Implement the full-stack change (database migration + OfficeFloor
server + front-end). Do NOT edit the pinned scaffolding (bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop,
bin/e2e, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md) or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The test passes.

The change request — "narrow the all-invoices list to one stage" — is a status filter on the Invoices page. Since the `/api/invoices` endpoint already returns each invoice's `status` and the seed support already handles it, this was a small, additive front-end change:

- Added a `data-testid="invoice-status-filter"` `<select>` to `AllInvoicesPage.tsx`, populated with the distinct stages present (plus an "All" default).
- Selecting a stage filters the rendered `invoice-row-*` rows to that status; "All" shows everything.

No schema or server changes were needed — the backend and seed path already surface `status`. `bin/e2e` builds, starts, and passes the Playwright spec (1 passed).
